definitions: To take unfair advantage of someone or something.
To ask someone to do something that requires a lot of their time or effort, especially when it is inconvenient for them.
To force something unwelcome or unfamiliar onto someone or something.
examples: I hope I'm not imposing on you by staying an extra night.
The government tried to impose new taxes on the citizens.
pastTenses: imposed on (simple past), imposed on (present perfect)
